_comment: ComfyUI API-format img2img workflow for running a Pershing Metabolizer
viewport screenshot through the site's own trained LoRA (2026-07-28).
What this is FOR, conceptually: the 3D viewport render is the design
proposal -- what the instrument computed from real data. The LoRA is the
site's remembered appearance, learned from its own photographic archive.
Running one through the other, with denoise as the mixing control, asks
how much of the proposal survives contact with the site's memory. At low
denoise the geometry holds and only surface/atmosphere is recalled; at
high denoise the memory overwrites the proposal entirely. That sweep is
the argument, and denoise is a fourth dial alongside sketch_alpha,
data_alpha and LoRA strength.
Node ids (auto-detected by logic/lora_decay_series.py, listed for
reference only):
1  CheckpointLoaderSimple
2  LoraLoader
3  CLIPTextEncode  (positive, via KSampler link)
4  CLIPTextEncode  (negative, via KSampler link)
6  KSampler        (denoise < 1.0 is what makes this img2img)
8  SaveImage
10  LoadImage       (filename is set after upload to ComfyUI's input/)
11  VAEEncode       (image -> latent, replacing EmptyLatentImage)
Uses only vanilla nodes. Export replacements with Save (API Format).
